projects.title: s-SNOM Spectrum Calculator
projects.description: A Python toolkit and interactive app for calculating s-SNOM spectra of bulk materials and layered samples, and comparing them with experimental data.

projects.title: Multilayer Anisotropic Transfer Matrix
projects.description: A Python package and interactive app for calculating optical reflection, dispersion and isofrequency maps in layered anisotropic media.

projects.title: Materials Library
projects.description: A Python library of referenced optical material models for infrared simulations, including permittivity tensors and sheet conductivity.

projects.title: SNOM Synthetic Holography Preview App
projects.description: A desktop tool for reconstructing and inspecting SNOM holograms, with interactive amplitude and phase views, filtering controls and image export.
